thread:
vijay: heads up — got a support ticket where provisional token exports spike during cross-region reconnects. customer routed to fallback region and then retried; billing export shows two provisional rows for what looks like the same logical session.
lina: do we have traces? is session_id present?
vijay: trace excerpt attached in ticket, session_id present but different region prefixes. simplified log: ```
[2025-07-01T12:10:00Z] session=org-9 prefix=0x12 attempt=regA-1 region=us-west tool_call tokens=300
[2025-07-01T12:10:03Z] network hiccup -> client reconnect region=eu-central new_attempt=regB-1 session=org-9 prefix=0x12 tool_call tokens=300 provisional=true
[2025-07-01T12:10:18Z] final_ack regB-1 confirmed=true
```
harper: Interesting — router in fallback region generated a fresh attempt id with region prefix, and ledger keyed by attempt id so we got separate provisional entries. But since session_id present we should have correlated. Did router drop original attempt mapping?
michael: ops-bot shows an autoscaling move that shifted some traffic during that minute. ops-bot: router pool rebalanced us-west->eu at 2025-07-01T12:09:59Z
ops-bot: autoscaler: router rebalancing triggered for low-capacity pool, move completed 12:09:59Z
lina: this suggests attempt->session mapping wasn't propagated across regions. dedupe currently uses attempt id only; we need a cross-region dedupe key that includes session_id.
vijay: proposal: change dedupe precedence: if session_id present, dedupe key = (org_id + session_id + prefix_hash + resume_offset if present). If session id absent, fall back to (attempt_id). Also emit ledger tag original_region and cross_region_replay boolean.
harper: telemetry: emit fields `replay_cross_region` (bool), `origin_region`, `replay_region`, `session_linked` (bool), and `attempt_chain` (comma list hint) so we can query replays across regions.
michael: short-term mitigation: when router receives a reconnect from same session within grace_window (10s) and prefix matches, emit `original_attempt_id` on replay events even if region differs. Ledger will mark replay as provisional_replay and not finalize until ack.
billing-bot: billing-bot: Please add ledger export fields: provisional=true/false, provisional_reason=(cross_region_replay|network_retry|client_retry), original_attempt_id, origin_region, provisional_hold (true/false). We'll include these in CSV.
lina: UX: console should default to confirmed-only view; add "Include provisional (in-flight)" toggle for billing reports. Add a tooltip: "Provisional rows may include retries or cross-region replays; final confirmed charges shown by default."
vijay: risk: cross-region de-dupe could underbill if customer legitimately retried in another region after >grace_window. Keep conservative: mark replay provisional and require final_ack to confirm. show quick "explain" link that surfaces the related traces.
harper: long-term: persist short-lived attempt mapping in a global store with regional replication and TTL 2min so cross-region correlation is reliable. also push SDK change to require session_id+resume_seq in new minor release.
michael: i'll open INFRA-2788 to prototype the global attempt map and BILL-1305 for ledger schema updates.
vijay: i'll draft a short RFC for dedupe precedence + telemetry schema and include a console mock for the toggle + explain flow. pairing volunteers? harper + michael for infra + ledger.
lina: i'll mock console copy and alert rule: org-alert when provisional_sum - confirmed_sum > 750 tokens in 5m.
billing-bot: BILL-1305 filed. ops-bot: INFRA-2788 created.
vijay: thanks team — i'll attach customer trace to the RFC and start the PR after reviews. :white_check_mark:
